verification.notes: Stage 2 is the local test stand (docs/operations.md, «Тестовый стенд»; ADR-0015). Its data lives only in the git-ignored .env.stand (PIGEON_STAND_TOKEN, PIGEON_STAND_CHAT_ID, PIGEON_STAND_ADMIN_ID, PIGEON_STAND_MEMBER_ID): your own test bot, test group, your account as admin and a second bot as a plain member. Never commit or print it. Checks: the image builds from the working tree and refuses to start without a token; then the harness runs the bot of the working tree on the test token, feeds synthetic updates to the dispatcher (no polling) and sends real Bot API calls to the test group. Exit 0 passed, 1 a check failed, 2 the stand refused (no config, production bot, bot not in the group, no network). Evidence: stand-runs/<time>-commands/report.json carries the revision (commit, dirty), every update fed and every Bot API call with Telegram's answer; attach report.public.json (stand ids redacted) to the Issue. answerCallbackQuery for a synthetic query is rejected by Telegram by design and marked expected_error. Without .env.stand Stage 2 is unreachable on this machine: say so and narrow to Stage 1. Still manual: privacy mode, the @bot suffix, how menus and popups look in a client, a real anonymous admin message, scheduler arrivals.
